data.name: Yashoda
data.gender_notes: Yashoda is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Giver of fame; mother of Krishna
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit yaśas, 'fame', + dā, 'to give' — 'giver of fame'. Its root is Sanskrit yaśas + dā. Yashoda, the foster-mother of Krishna. Yashoda is a Sanskrit name meaning “Giver of fame; mother of Krishna”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.etymology: From the Sanskrit yaśas, 'fame', + dā, 'to give' — 'giver of fame'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yashoda total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
